companies_logo_complete.name: companies_logo_complete
companies_logo_complete.value: ("companies"."logo" is null and "companies"."logo_mime" is null) or ("companies"."logo" is not null and "companies"."logo_mime" is not null and "companies"."logo_mime" in ('image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp'))

invoices_status_timestamps.name: invoices_status_timestamps
invoices_status_timestamps.value: ("invoices"."status" = 'draft' and "invoices"."sent_at" is null and "invoices"."paid_at" is null) or ("invoices"."status" = 'sent' and "invoices"."sent_at" is not null and "invoices"."paid_at" is null) or ("invoices"."status" = 'paid' and "invoices"."sent_at" is not null and "invoices"."paid_at" is not null)

projects_ongoing_has_dates.name: projects_ongoing_has_dates
projects_ongoing_has_dates.value: "projects"."status" <> 'ongoing' or ("projects"."start_date" is not null and "projects"."end_date" is not null)

projects_end_after_start.name: projects_end_after_start
projects_end_after_start.value: "projects"."start_date" is null or "projects"."end_date" is null or "projects"."end_date" >= "projects"."start_date"

recurring_rules_month_matches_frequency.name: recurring_rules_month_matches_frequency
recurring_rules_month_matches_frequency.value: ("recurring_rules"."frequency" = 'yearly' and "recurring_rules"."month_of_year" is not null and "recurring_rules"."month_of_year" between 1 and 12) or ("recurring_rules"."frequency" = 'monthly' and "recurring_rules"."month_of_year" is null)

transactions_rule_has_occurrence.name: transactions_rule_has_occurrence
transactions_rule_has_occurrence.value: "transactions"."recurring_rule_id" is null or "transactions"."occurrence_date" is not null
